387: Pražské služby Day and a cycling day
388: This time we rode as two teams. Michal Budský and the youngest, Tobík Dolák, headed near Sokolov for a local cycling day that was unfortunately rained out. The guys battled the weather, but of course the weather affects everything. Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek and 3 little ones from the Kabeláč clan set off for the Pražské služby exhibition, where in two shows by the main stage they showed what can and can't be done on bikes. The second show was extended with an exhibition by the parkour guys and a Vlasta vs parkour battle (the result is secret :))
390: We held a slightly different camp – or rather a Wednesday afternoon course – for enthusiasts who want to improve their bike technique. A few enduro riders and one action-loving female biker came along; with Katarína Tóthová they went through the basics and also threw themselves into fine-tuning berms and the other delights you meet on and off the trail.
391: Exhibitions and workshops in Černovice, Říčky, Kvítkov and Nový Oldřichov
392: Half of August is gone and our team hasn't stopped. We started in Žimutice at a small village harvest festival, where Čihi and Lukáš Valný rode.
393: A few individual MTB and Trial courses followed. On 8/8 we were supposed to have a double exhibition, but unfortunately one was cancelled because of the death of the organiser, a long-time client of ours. So we headed to Černovice, where the 20th edition of 'Černovicko se baví' took place. An hour-long workshop followed by an exhibition on the main stage, and a reunion after many years between Martin Šimůnek and the host and sound engineer.
394: And this weekend, on 15/8, we did 3 exhibitions: Lukáš Valný and Marek Tryner did an intimate event in Říčky near the local bike park, while Šimon, Čihi and the little ones went to an event in Kvítkov near Česká Lípa and then opened for the band NoName in Mistrovice. So we alternated between audiences of a few dozen visitors and an event for a few thousand people. To be honest, all the events were accompanied by exhausting heat, which has hopefully eased for a week now, but we're grateful for the invitations and the chance to present our sport.
395: For everyone who's bored over the summer holidays, as well as enthusiasts who want to perfect their technique, we prepared a small camp in the middle of the holidays. Katarína Tóthová took charge of the group of women and girls, and Vlasta looked after a group of bike-hungry guys. The weather was a bit disappointing, with beautiful sunshine alternating with local showers. Luckily it didn't affect morale, so the rainy breaks were used for a small workshop or a chat. Thanks to everyone for taking part – keep polishing your newly acquired skills.
396: Náplavka charity festival in Kostelec nad Orlicí
397: The charity festival on the riverside in Kostelec nad Orlicí was incredibly lucky. Not only did the guys ride there, but above all, on a totally rainy day it didn't rain until the end of our exhibition. A wall of water the whole way, and sunshine only on the riverside, which ended with the end of the exhibition – and even then it continued only with light drizzle.
398: After arriving, Vlasta and Lukáš managed to park in the slightly cramped space, get the obstacles out and jump straight into the exhibition. There were plenty of people and they cheered like crazy, so a few bigger jumps came out, maybe right on the edge. By the time we got to the volunteers it started to drizzle lightly, but everything was handled without interruption. Thanks for the invitation.
400: {1}"For a few years now, local guys and riders at races and exhibitions I take part in with colleagues from the TRIALSHOW.cz team have been chasing me to teach them this or that. Until now, priority went to Trial training in our club and finishing the leisure park in Tehov, but now that everything is up and running, it's time to move from an idea to a final project"{2} {3}Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček{4}, founder of the project.
401: Our gradually growing team of instructors, including names such as {1}Martin Šimůnek{2}, {3}Marek Tryner{4} and {5}Lukáš Valný{6}, aims to teach what some of them have been doing every day for 30 years. Correct riding technique on and off-road is the foundation of everything, and who else should pass it on than Trial riders? We want to offer something different from what's currently available on the market and take a less trodden path in coaching.
402: Our priority is {1}individual training{2} and {3}training for small groups{4} of riders. We'll also offer standard camps or rides, but only in limited numbers and again for fewer riders.
403: We're already arranging several {1}workshops{2} across the country which, combined with our exhibition, can be an attractive part of the programme at a sports, municipal or cultural event.
404: And since we've been working with a number of leading Czech brands for a long time, our goal will be to gradually fill our {1}Shop{2} with products we've tested and know you can rely on.
406: Here's a short invitation from our partner to test DVO shocks and forks at Bike Park Špičák on 30–31 May 2020.
407: Just turn up and register on site. If we have time and the chance, we'll see you there too.
409: {1}UPDATE: Katarína reached her goal, although a bit differently than she wanted. Look forward to it – the book is happening.{2}
410: Katarína has launched a HITHIT campaign to support the publication of her book.
411: In brief, what it's all about:
412: New Bikeinstruktor book on mountain bike riding technique
413: The new Bikeinstruktor book will teach you to ride more technically
414: Bikeinstruktor – a book for beginner bikers – is coming out
415: Improve your bike skills with the new Bikeinstruktor book
416: The book Bikeinstruktor presents technique {1}step by step{2} in a simple, clear way – useful if you want more from your bike than just eating up kilometres. It's a manual for everyone, regardless of age or experience.
417: The book is complemented by a large number of {1}detailed illustrations{2}, often broken down into individual sequences. Thanks to its 17 cm x 17 cm format it fits into a backpack or a handbag.
418: In it you'll find the basic {1}skills{2}, from balance and riding through corners to jumping. There's also a chapter on building obstacles, first aid, basic bike care and a list of places to ride in the Czech Republic. And there are quite a few of them!
419: The book was written by {1}Katarína Tóthová{2} based on her experience from racing and coaching. In her biking career she became a {3}two-time national champion{4} in downhill, overall winner of the Czech Downhill Cup, runner-up in four-cross and third in BMX racing. She is a former member of the national team and has extensive experience in dirt, dual, pump track and enduro.
420: At the moment you can get the book {1}in advance at a discounted price{2} through the crowdfunding campaign on Hithit. There you choose your reward (e.g. a signed book delivered to your home) and the amount of your contribution. You'll receive your reward after the 30-day campaign ends.
421: Support the project to publish the book. You'll learn to ride more technically and more safely.
427: Exhibition performance in Lipová near Cheb
428: After quite a while, Vlasta and Lukáš went to see Vláďa Keblůžek in Lipová near Cheb, where the village ball was held. Besides a performance by dancers from StarDance, there was a midnight surprise led by the Trialshow team. A great audience atmosphere and a few actors with suicidal tendencies in the role of volunteers helped us a lot. The spectators also dived headfirst into the competition, and thanks to the great surface and high ceiling we managed to show plenty of tricks. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you again sometime.
430: {1}23/8 – {2}{3}Hovězí+ festival exhibition – charity exhibition in Velešín{4}
431: Light rain before the show didn't stop us, and Vlasta and Tobík performed our classic show at the local festival combined with a contest for the best goulash. The beef one won, of course, and the guys got to taste it. Thanks for the invitation.
433: Luckily we didn't have to go and sit in the local prison – we just had to celebrate the local festival with concerts in a nearby park. The line-up of Vlasta and Michal Budský was unexpectedly joined by our friend Hannes Hermann (multiple German champion), so the locals got to see a truly first-class Trial show.
435: Once again we were invited to Pardubice for the traditional road trade fair focused on technology and projects related to roads and related services. The exhibition took place by the main stage and was also shown on LED screens around the grounds. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta had about 20 minutes to demonstrate their sporting art.
436: {1}6/9 – Triple exhibition in Stonařov, Vraňany and Choceň{2}
437: Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský headed to a sports day in Choceň, where they entertained athletes and spectators in 3 short shows. At the same time Vlasta and Lukáš Valný set off for Stonařov for a farewell to summer with a fairly decent turnout. After the show they had to quickly pack the obstacles and bikes and head to Vraňany for the local fair. All exhibitions done – this time Martin and Michal won on number of shows, but Vlasta and Lukáš won on kilometres. Thanks to all the organisers for the invitations.
438: {1}13/9 – Double exhibition in Říčany and Kunratice{2}
439: This time we rode on our doorstep. For our home club, together with the club's little ones, we rode a show with 8 riders on the Lázeňská louka meadow in Říčany, where leisure activities and clubs were being presented. We spent some time on the meadow, greeted all our friends and fans, and after training with the kids, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš Valný headed to nearby Kunratice, where a children's day organised by the local theatre took place in the beautiful setting of the chateau park. By the main stage we rode an exhibition, also using the stage, and although it didn't look like it at first, with a decent crowd. The show was originally supposed to be ridden by Martin Šimůnek, who injured his back – we wish him a speedy recovery. Thanks for the invitation.
440: Ferdinand Bušta Memorial schools cycling race
441: After almost 6 years, the organisers of a cycling race for schools and nurseries around Suchdol nad Lužnicí contacted us again. Loads of buses and several hundred kids gathered at the Pískovna campsite, all wanting to grab medals for their school or nursery in individual or team competitions. Part of the programme was an exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek, who showed their Trial art in two shows and organised small competitions for volunteers. Long live cycling – hopefully see you next time.
442: Exhibitions at Padrťské pláně, Modřany and coaching
443: We were really busy this day. Mára Tryner was preparing to coach  a small group of enthusiasts. Lukáš Valný and Matouš were ready for the advanced camp, and Martin and Vlasta were doing the rounds of exhibitions.
444: Changes in the weather meant everything got a bit complicated. Mára had to move his lesson. The camp was cancelled (riders could sign up for the next weekend), and the first of the two exhibitions was really for the brave.
445: The Brdy forests are a truly beautiful place, and the event itself was on a beautiful large clearing in the middle. Unfortunately the weather wasn't kind to the organisers – it rained practically non-stop and a cold wind blew. Luckily some spectators weren't put off, and the organiser provided enough fire pits to warm up and roast sausages. We tried to run our workshop in the breaks between rain showers, and finally in the late afternoon we got a 15-minute break when even the sun peeked out. We rode a quick exhibition, which ended not only with applause from the spectators but also with a proper downpour.
446: After quickly packing up the obstacles we headed for Prague-Modřany, where a crowd at a company party was waiting for us. Luckily without rain by then, we could fully show what we can do and entertain the diverse audience of this multicultural company.
448: It was time for the second day camp for young male and female bikers, which we organise with our home club MTB Trial Mraveniště. The weather was spot on and the kids rode even more than last time. Lots of riders came back to us, and it's great to see someone enjoying it so much that they come to two camps in a row.
449: Instructors Katarína and Matěj and carers Lucka and Lenka put their hearts into it, and you can see the youngsters appreciate it. This time we had no serious injury requiring hospital treatment, and there was time for Trial training for those who had bikes, as well as an Enduro ride on nearby trails for the oldest riders led by Vlasta.
451: Another rainy exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík is history. It took some experience to cope with the gravel, pebbles and mud, but the guys went for it to please all the enthusiasts who weren't put off by the rain. The organiser even checked whether it wasn't dangerous to climb on the bike, but after being assured that yes, it's dangerous, but the guys don't care, she gave up. The spectators egged the guys on to a solid 125 cm in the sideways jump, which had to be done instead of the volunteers (nobody would have lain down under the guys in the rain anyway).
